proposedContributions.change: Define shared runtime-validated discriminated contracts for MD/OPML/JSONCanvas/PNG/SVG and all eight required errors. Require revisioned canonical Doc ref, authority epoch where applicable, theme/layout revision, full or explicit branch IDs, asset/fallback policy and preview digest. Manifest records source snapshot hashes/revisions, format/version/supports/losses, authorized scope IDs/count, asset outcomes/mapping, font/layout/viewport choices and immutable output FileRef+SHA256. MD consumes retained original spans, not reconstructed heading text; textual codecs compare supported stable IDs, parent/order, text and declared metadata after parsing. Proposed symbol names are design contributions, not existing APIs.

Resolve canonical snapshot through accepted dependencies and authenticated authority; validate revisions, scope and assets on preview and render. Persist preview binding via existing command/owner mechanisms rather than a new tree store. Changed source/layout/theme makes preview stale/conflict, never a mixed live export. Build isolated bounded SVG/PNG render from frozen data; allowlist vector elements/attributes/links and approved resolved asset bytes, no script/event/unsafe URL or external fetch. Finalize through EG-FILES with exact-byte SHA256 and emit verified artifact.created envelope only through the accepted durable command/outbox owner. Expose progress/cancel through approved transport and owner cancellation semantics; acknowledge completion only after durable receipt and authoritative readback.

Build a controlled review panel inside the existing Docs/Map surface (not a separate shell/store). Typed API inputs come from the current canonical document/view binding. Show format/scope/assets/fallback and precise loss/support report before confirmation; distinguish previewing/rendering/cancelled/stale/conflict/denied/error/committed/readback states. Show explicit font/layout/viewport choices for raster/vector, source revision/theme, receipt FileRef/hash, progress/cancel, accessible help and Escape focus restoration. Use t(), current user theme, reduced motion and actual Rox Mono font evidence. Host mounting and locale integration need reviewed additional seams.

Deterministic seeded supported-codec roundtrip assertions for IDs/text/parent/order and declared losses; retain non-tree source bytes and opaque metadata; denied asset URL removal and SVG injection controls; immutable snapshot under concurrent edits; exact artifact-byte hash and durable readback/replay/restart against the real owner lane. Separate native receipts from isolated unit fixture results.

risks: Current heading Outline IDs change with rename/reorder; do not export them as durable list node identities.
parseNoteDocument is a summary; roundTripNoteMarkdown and native stampBlockMarkers normalize source bytes and cannot satisfy non-tree prose/BOM/CRLF preservation by themselves.
Native engine read and revision objects are mutable references; late edits can mix revisions unless rendering resolves an immutable owner snapshot.
Personal collapsed/focus/viewport state can silently remove authorized branches if export traverses only rendered nodes; selected branch and full tree must be explicit scopes.
contentHash is not cryptographic artifact SHA256; existing vault export is not the common immutable file export owner.
SurfaceContext visibility/permissionMode is not current transport ACL. Denied/missing asset reports must not leak protected URLs/names; imported ACL does not grant access.
Raster font, Cyrillic glyphs, decoder and sandbox budgets require separate real runtime acceptance; a syntactically valid SVG or mock canvas is insufficient.
The sole shared path's named Base utilities cannot register authenticated APIs or mount the review panel. Broadening source paths without a reviewed packet violates the bounded slice.

Published RS-DOC-01 uses a different historical source SHA and collaborative Page framing; reconcile accepted identity/authority capabilities without adding another tree/content/comments store or importing unrelated feature scope.
Any root integration changing source bytes makes the affected report evidence historical; all future behavioral receipts must bind to the integrated revision.
Actual product verification is deliberately NOT_RUN here. Preflight lineage/hash validation only demonstrates report integrity, never feature completion.
